verification: Every batch read through expected_identity/read_result (identity + SHA256) and its receipt SHA256 recomputed from the file; images finite; all seven images channels sum exactly into detector.npz (images[0..3] == category_fluence, [4] == photon_count, [5] == energy_sum_keV, [6] == energy_sum2_keV2, assert_array_equal) and the recomputed n_batches_hit matches; detector.npz n_batches == 500 and n_histories == 1e8.
limitations: Per-pixel batch values are not kept, so cross-pixel batch covariance and any re-analysis over a subset of batches are lost. What is kept instead: the per-channel batch sum of squares (images_sum2, category_count_sum2), which detector.npz does not hold -- it exports only total_rel_err, one figure summed over categories -- so the per-pixel batch SEM stays recoverable for every channel; plus the per-batch channel totals and the per-batch scalars. category_count per-pixel sums are kept here because detector.npz exports category_fluence (energy/area), not the counts. No Drive copy.
deletion_method: mv of the listed raw NPZ directory to ~/.Trash after build+verify passed (compact table, receipts and retained-NPZ hashes checked). Emptying the Trash is the user step; until then the raw files are still recoverable. Nothing was unlinked by this script.
